findings.finding: Legacy dashboard vocabulary and content remained visible behind the Shorts workflow.
findings.root_fix: Shorts focus mode hides the legacy complete workspace while preserving the canonical main window and sidebar.

findings.finding: Zero-candidate state exposed an oversized empty preview/list area and an expanding recovery card.
findings.root_fix: Empty preview/list are collapsed; candidate-page heading/card bounds and top alignment keep the explanation and recovery action compact and visible.

findings.finding: Candidate checkbox selection emitted a boolean into a zero-argument signal and blocked the UI continuation path.
findings.root_fix: The checkbox signal is normalized through a zero-argument lambda before reaching the existing selection-change contract.
